extra.message: Security headers are explicitly disabled. The response sets X-XSS-Protection to '0' and clears the Content-Security-Policy header. This removes browser-level protections against cross-site scripting attacks, making the application more vulnerable to XSS exploits.

User-controlled Origin header is reflected directly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header without validation. This allows any website to make cross-origin requests to this endpoint and read the responses. Combined with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, this exposes sensitive data to malicious websites.
